description: This file defines API endpoints related to message management, including creating, listing, retrieving, updating, deleting, and processing messages within a web service using FastAPI and SQLAlchemy.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI APIRouter instance used to define message-related API routes.

methods.name: create_message(payload: MessageCreate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Creates a new message with pending status and returns the created message.

methods.name: list_messages(db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all messages, ordered by creation time descending.

methods.name: get_message(message_id: uuid.UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Retrieves a message by its UUID; raises 404 if not found.

methods.name: update_message(message_id: uuid.UUID, payload: MessageUpdate, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(require_roles("admin")))
methods.description: Updates a message's status or JIRA link; restricted to admin role.

methods.name: delete_message(message_id: uuid.UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(require_roles("admin")))
methods.description: Deletes a message by its UUID; restricted to admin role.

methods.name: process_message(message_id: uuid.UUID, db: AsyncSession = Depends(get_db), _=Depends(require_roles("admin")))
methods.description: Runs processing rules on a message and returns the updated message; restricted to admin role.
